candidates.statement: Inventory's redis.reserve_inventory spans error at 1350ms with 9 redis_operation_timeout 504 log events and 18 dependency_timeouts, while inventory p95 is 920ms; gateway's call to inventory errors at 947ms. This supports a redis timeout on the inventory-to-redis dependency as the bounded root cause.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side telemetry is absent; timeout cause (redis saturation vs network) is not established.

report.explanation: Inventory traces show redis.reserve_inventory errors at 1350ms, matching 9 redis_operation_timeout 504 logs and 18 dependency_timeouts with elevated p95 (920ms); gateway's inventory call errors at 947ms. Gateway metrics/logs are healthy, so the fault is bounded to the inventory-to-redis dependency. Deployment record alone does not establish causation.
missing_evidence: Redis server metrics (latency, connections, saturation) for the incident window
Redis-side logs or traces confirming timeout origin
